criteria.statement: Service, browser, and ContextVM relay policy sources are independently configurable in backend config.
ContextVM relay resolution falls back to browser relays only when contextvm_relays is absent and does not mutate the explicit configured source.
nostr.relays remains a backend/service compatibility alias and is not the browser relay policy source.
Legacy private mirror fields remain non-configurable and rejected from YAML and environment input.
AUTH-unavailable semantics are fixed to exclude_and_fail and invalid fallback policies are rejected.
